budget.note: 100 s x $0.14 + 22 first frames x $0.08. Shot 6 is generated at Kling's 3 s minimum and trimmed to 2 s in the edit.

narration.say_en: Peak divided by one server's Q P S,
plus thirty to fifty percent headroom.

title.zh: 一张图：估算 QPS 三步

steps.zh: ① 总请求 = 人数 × 人均请求：1,000 万 × 10 = 1 亿
② 峰值 QPS = 总请求 ÷ 高峰秒数：1 亿 ÷ 600 ≈ 17 万（别除 86,400）
③ 机器数 = 峰值 ÷ 单机 QPS + 30–50% 余量：≈ 85 台起

notes.zh: 10 分钟也是平均，最忙那一秒更高 → 所以留余量
notes.en: 10 minutes is still an average; the busiest second is higher → headroom

notes.zh: 多租一晚的钱 ≪ 开播崩一次的损失
notes.en: One night of extra servers ≪ one crash on air

footnote.zh: 假设：高峰 10 分钟；单机 2,000 QPS 以压测为准

content.q_zh: 一百万人一分钟内涌进来，每人请求六次，峰值 QPS 大约多少？A 一万，B 十万
content.q_en: 1M people arrive within one minute, 6 requests each. Peak QPS: A) 10,000 or B) 100,000?
content.answer_zh: 答案：B。100 万 × 6 = 600 万次请求，按一分钟内均匀到达估算：600 万 ÷ 60 = 10 万 QPS。
content.answer_en: Answer: B. 1M × 6 = 6M requests; spread evenly over 60 seconds, 6M ÷ 60 = 100,000 QPS.
